canonicalTitle: Find the Unknown Addend PLC Activity

stageA.warmup: Choral Count from 97 decreasing by 10: 97,87,77,67,57,47,37,27,17,7. Learners explain tens/ones pattern.
stageA.activity1: How Did You Find It? Students compare base-ten blocks and connecting cubes; solve original 41+?=84 =>43 with varied addition/subtraction and place-value methods; real blocks and partner conversations teacher assessed.
stageA.activity2: You Go This Way, I'll Go That Way. Han starts with 17, Mai with 48, both solve17+?=48 =>31. Independent partner task21+?=96=>75; select from strategies that add-on or subtract. Actual pair roleplay teacher assessed.
stageA.synthesis: Original 67−55=12 and55+?=67 =>12, compare subtraction with missing addition.
stageA.sourceRestriction: Add/subtract within100 without regrouping tens, connect both operation methods, use base-ten blocks and connecting cubes purposefully.
stageA.educatorRestrictedCoolDown: Find the Unknown Addend; Edulytics must independently author its exit ticket, not assert publisher restricted question text.
stageA.sourceMaterials: Group of 2, 90–100 connecting cubes total with no more than three to five ten-towers initially, plus base-ten blocks; no claim of digital simulation being actual physical manipulation.
stageA.sourceRights: Original source values and learning goals attributed; no copied publisher artwork. Teacher-only original collaborative reasoning cannot be machine certified.
stageA.sourceNamingCaveat: Canonical includes 'PLC Activity' suffix, public source page simply titles it 'Find the Unknown Addend'.
